description: Fetches KFC restaurant location data from locations.kfc.com, including store listings by state/city and detailed store information (address, phone, hours, services, coordinates).

function.description:
Function to call. Available values:
  - list_states   List all US states with their codes for building queries
  - list_cities   List all cities/locations in a state with direct store links
  - list_stores   List all KFC stores in a specific city
  - get_store     Get detailed info for a single store (address, phone, coords, services, hours)
  - fetch         Auto-detect and fetch any page type

state.description: Two-letter state code (lowercase), e.g. 'ny', 'ca', 'tx'. Used by list_cities.

city_path.description: City path in format "state/city-name", e.g. "ny/bronx", "ca/los-angeles". Used by list_stores.

store_url.description: Full URL to store detail page, e.g. "https://locations.kfc.com/ny/new-york/2-penn-plaza". Used by get_store.

path.description: Relative URL path, e.g. "/ny", "/ny/bronx", "/ny/new-york/2-penn-plaza". Used by fetch function which auto-detects page type.
